risks.risk: Cylinder may be past its safety expiry date
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturing date (often stamped as MM/YY) on the handle or base ring.

risks.risk: Fresh paint may be concealing deep structural rust or pitting
risks.proof: A photo of the bottom foot ring and the underside of the cylinder.

proof_requests: Photo of the stamped manufacturing and expiry dates on the shroud (handle).
Photo of the weight and 'tare' markings stamped on the metal.
Photo of the bottom of the cylinder to check for rust.
response.reason: The item is a standard gas cylinder. While its age and internal condition are hidden by new paint, it can be priced at its worst-case value as a refurbished/expired unit.
